annotations.title: P-Video 2 Pro Replace: new person, same video

description: Replace the person in a video with one or two people from your pictures; lips and expressions follow the source. 768p, as long as the source. Compared with other video tools: premium. Price: from $0.135 per second (one call: from $0.676 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.676, 10 $1.351, 15 $2.026 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

images.description: 1 picture (one person) or 2 pictures (two people), https URLs. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

max_seconds.description: Longest the source video can be; sets the price. Longer videos are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

video.description: Source video as an MP4 link (https); the result is as long as this video. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)
